role: Independent Agency Model QA Specialist; novelty red-team
status: Usable evidence map, not proof of global novelty or publication readiness

task_contract.input: Observed empty shell incl doors/windows/height + exact required furniture IDs/counts/text. Sizes and poses unknown.
task_contract.output: Complete size/pose layout, then common RoomGenBench asset realization.
task_contract.user_constraints: Prefer lightweight workflow; user will provide revised workflow later. No assumption it is implemented.
task_contract.reported_result: User reports GPT one-shot > LayoutVLM > FastFill under two screenshot evaluations. Treat as evidence the strong baseline must be retained; sample size,protocol,budget and evaluator reliability not established here. Do not explain ranking away or claim statistical significance.
task_contract.critical_realization_gate: Current RoomGenBench anisotropic exact-fit rescales each asset into predicted bbox, removing native dimension variation. Native-size uncertainty is not automatically an actual failure mode of this pipeline. Require user workflow confirmation before choosing size robustness; exact-fit branch should study shape/contact/function differences or deformation, not native-dimension mismatch.

prior_source_audit_entries.name: SceneNAT: Masked Generative Modeling for Language-Guided Indoor Scene Synthesis
NaLA: A 3D Native LLM Layout Agent for High-quality 3D Scene Generation
SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes

scope.count_note: Prior combined artifacts contain15entries when SemLayoutDiff is included, rather than silently force a14count. RoomGenBench is a code framework without a verified standalone paper in prior audit.

targeted_primary_sources.title: Direct Numerical Layout Generation for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis via Spatial Reasoning
targeted_primary_sources.evidence: Already handles asset-layout mismatch with iterative evaluator feedback; adjusts size/position/orientation. Generated assets are resized to predicted dimensions. Asset feedback itself is not new.

targeted_primary_sources.title: RoboLayout: Differentiable 3D Scene Generation for Embodied Agents
targeted_primary_sources.evidence: Adds agent-aware reachability to LayoutVLM and reoptimizes problematic objects while freezing others. Local repair plus agent clearance is not new.

targeted_primary_sources.title: PhyScene: Physically Interactable 3D Scene Synthesis for Embodied AI
targeted_primary_sources.read_level: Official project method and supplementary reachability algorithm
targeted_primary_sources.evidence: Diffusion guidance for collision, floor boundaries and agent-size-dependent reachability; articulated retrieval. Geometry guidance, path clearance and physics-aware synthesis are prior art.

targeted_primary_sources.title: Global Graph-Validated Optimization for VLM-based 3D Indoor Scene Generation
targeted_primary_sources.evidence: Rule-based semantic graph validation plus evolutionary search and gradient refinement already separate semantics and physical feasibility. Limitations already propose lightweight asset prechecks for oversized/render-failing assets.

targeted_primary_sources.title: VIGOR: Verifiable Industrial Geometry Optimization and Repair in Scene Programs
targeted_primary_sources.evidence: Local projection then coupled conflict-graph repair preserves attachments and stops on feasibility/budget. Uses complete instance IDs and94geometric checks. Dataset filters for constructible cases;1749retained scenarios each11instances. Industrial domain, not same room task, but invalidates generic verify+repair novelty.

targeted_primary_sources.title: Function2Scene: 3D Indoor Scene Layout from Functional Specifications
targeted_primary_sources.evidence: Functional criteria and tool-augmented geometric/LLM/VLM check-and-repair already studied; functionality checker alone not new.

targeted_primary_sources.title: LEGO-Net: Learning Regular Rearrangements of Objects in Rooms
targeted_primary_sources.read_level: Prior primary-source audit; not fully reread this turn
targeted_primary_sources.evidence: Learned iterative denoising of fixed object sets with floor-plan conditioning and limited movement predates a learned layout corrector.

targeted_primary_sources.title: Scenic scene generation documentation
targeted_primary_sources.read_level: Official generation semantics and rejection/pruning behavior
targeted_primary_sources.evidence: Declarative hard constraints, probabilistic scene parameters and pruning already exist. Sampling exhaustion is not proof no satisfying scene exists.

targeted_primary_sources.title: Diagramming Program Values by Spatial Refinement
targeted_primary_sources.evidence: Adjacent2Dprogram-diagram domain already has spatial satisfiability, irreducible infeasible subsystems and counterfactual diagnostics. UNSAT explanations are not a new general concept.

targeted_primary_sources.title: SceneReVis: A Self-Reflective Vision-Grounded Framework for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis via Multi-turn RL
targeted_primary_sources.read_level: Primary method/mandatory-object extraction+verification prompts and GRPO descriptions checked this turn; paper runtime numbers supplied by parent but not used as speed comparison.
targeted_primary_sources.evidence: Already extracts mandatory object lists with repeated categories, verifies multiplicity and learns multi-turn visual diagnose/act with SFT+GRPO plus terminal physics optimization. Exact inventory checking, learned corrective agents or RL self-reflection alone cannot support novelty. Its mandatory object set includes inferred room essentials, whereas user task fixes explicit request IDs; that distinction is a protocol difference, not sufficient new algorithm.

scope.search_boundary: Targeted primary-source falsification as of2026-10-26; not systematic/exhaustive literature coverage. Public preprint claims used as prior art, not independently validated superiority.

sceneeval_author_fork_evidence.implication: Current author code already supplies210scene verification+physics plan and common support type assessment. Reusing evaluators strengthens a study, but is not a method novelty. Exact original paper-version linkage remained unverified in prior audit.

roomgen_assembly_evidence.source: Parent source audit of anisotropic bbox fit; authoritative for current workflow gate. No claim revised workflow uses this realization.

novelty_exclusions: Multi-agent orchestration or VLM critique loop
Actual-asset feedback or generic size/pose adjustment
Semantic graph verification or global-plus-local search
Exact inventory checks and reporting unknown/failure states as an algorithmic novelty by themselves
SFT+RL/GRPO learning of reflective edit trajectories or final physics optimization alone (SceneReVis)

first_gate.name: No-training pain-point probe before choosing a method
first_gate.effort: 0.5-2 engineer days if existing mesh assets/results are locally available; otherwise blocked on asset evidence, not justification to download/generate large assets now.
design: Freeze a canonical validation subset of30-50house-disjoint rooms, all requiredIDs and one available GPT one-shot result per room only if produced under same input protocol. Keep legacy full-condition GPT results labeled legacy, never relabel.

For each layout measure exact inventory, bbox geometry and door-seeded clearance at a declared agent width, then check existing realized meshes for true floor/object support and functional-side access. No new LLM critique calls.

If existing multiple assets/category available, reuse3-5realization seeds with identical matches across systems. Under exact-fit keep predicted bbox fixed; variation can test surface/contact/front/articulation, not native-size robustness. Under near-isotropic/native realization separately measure actual dimension mismatch and its consequences.
Record assembly/mesh/unknown failures in all-request denominator and categorize: semantic plan error, scale prediction error, shape/contact error, optimizer error, upstream data failure.
Cache measured outcomes; compare GPT raw, LayoutVLM raw and FastFill raw on same common geometry/realization, then identical deterministic repair on all.
go_no_go: If bbox pass -> mesh/function failures are rare or are mainly corrupt assets/coordinate errors, fix engineering and do not frame as a new robust-layout research problem.

If identical deterministic repair closes most of the gap to GPT and a learned component adds no measurable equal-budget benefit, build the lightweight product improvement but do not claim a new learned method.
If shape/native-size shift substantially changes validity at fixed input and the effect survives common asset policy and unknown/failure accounting, consider candidate1.
Stop any proposed candidate whose premise requires a realization mode the user workflow does not use.
analytical_caveats: Contained meshes with truly disjoint enclosingOBBs cannot gain object-object interpenetration solely from within-bbox shape change. Shape variation matters through support/contact, functional orientation, articulation, scale distortion or conservative false positives; identify which mechanism is real.

Identical bbox does not imply identical support surface: a hollow/open-top support can share the bbox with a solid top while failing to support a child at the center. This is a geometric reasoning example, not an executed real-mesh empirical result.

candidates.title: 对实际资产实现风险稳健的完整清单布局
candidates.current_verdict: Most task-specific potential, conditional on pain-point and realization-mode gates. Not yet established novel.
candidates.new_hypothesis: With no per-instance asset geometry at planning time, a lightweight representation of category/description-conditioned realization uncertainty can improve all-object downstream support/access validity at a fixed compute budget, over point-size prediction plus safety margins or post-hoc repair.
candidates.already_done: Asset retrieval, asset-layout reconciliation, size/pose adjustment, geometric clearance and asset prechecks. NaLA starts with native assets, a different information regime.
candidates.possible_unproved_delta: Plan before realizing asset shape with a calibrated risk/recourse objective; distinguish size-mode and exact-fit shape-mode; preserve all requiredIDs and semantics under a common asset distribution. Must demonstrate advantage over standard margin inflation/scenario optimization, not rename robust optimization.
candidates.lightweight_method_sketch: Reuse one LLM scaffold. Use cached non-GT category/style size or support-surface statistics and a small number of cheap realization scenarios to reserve contact/access margins; optional tiny residual scorer chooses corrections. No additional VLM loop, multiagent runtime or new asset generator required. This is a design proposal, not claimed implementation.

realization_branches.native_or_near_isotropic: If workflow keeps native/aspect-ratio-constrained assets, predict size distributions from train/catalog data; evaluate dimension mismatch and same-inventory feasibility across real asset draws.
realization_branches.current_anisotropic_exact_fit: Native dimension shift largely removed; study support-surface/front/articulation failure or deformation under fixed bbox. Without evidence these affect final success, do not pursue this candidate.

minimum_experiment.phase0: First_gate probe using30-50validation rooms and3-5cached assets/seed draws where available.
minimum_experiment.phase1: Use fixed initial GPT scaffold for all methods, same allowed asset information, same realization seeds and repair budget. Compare nominal point estimate, uniform margin inflation, per-class quantile margin, sampled/scenario deterministic repair and proposed risk method. Include actual-geometry oracle as labeled upper bound only.
minimum_experiment.phase2: Freeze method on validation; final untouched source/house-disjoint set with density and source strata. Repeated assets/seeds nested within rooms, not independent rooms.

metrics: All-requiredID realized success / all requested rooms
True mesh support/contact and door-seeded function access;unknown rates
Tail/CVaR or worst-decile violation under heldout realization shift; declare failure threshold
Expected/p95 total layout+repair time; asset calls held equal
Native mode only: dimension/aspect ratio error and amount of prohibited resizing
ablations: No uncertainty (point mean), same risk budget
Shuffled priors and heldout catalog/style/source shifts
Risk-aware ordering versus same repairs with simple geometry ordering
Raw and repaired outputs for GPT/LayoutVLM/FastFill; equal common repair on each
Oracle actual shape/size labels a separate information upper bound
falsification: Exact-fit realization eliminates the claimed size failure mode.
Uniform padding or equal-budget scenario solver matches result.
Gain comes from enlarged rooms, dropping IDs, flattening/squashing assets, giving candidate GT geometry or extra expensive asset/VLM calls.
Support/access gains disappear on heldout actual meshes or are outweighed by semantic quality loss.
Risk calibration fails under catalog/style shift; do not advertise a guarantee outside tested distribution.
candidates.proposed_pilot_thresholds_not_facts: Pre-register practical effect after probe; e.g.>=5percentage-point paired all-object success improvement over best equal-budget nonlearned baseline, with no meaningful blind-quality degradation. Small pilot is directional, not significance proof.

cost.credible real-mesh study: 2-4weeks plus asset access and evaluation budget; depends on prevalence of failure
cost.training: None for first gate; tiny scorer optional only after deterministic controls

candidates.title: 一次LLM规划后的等预算学习修复与计算分配
candidates.current_verdict: Strong engineering baseline, high novelty collision risk as a standalone paper. Do not lead with LLM+solver/local repair.
candidates.new_hypothesis: A small learned policy can allocate a strict correction budget and preserve semantics better than deterministic/gradient/local-search repair when repairing dense, unknown-size-inventory layouts from a frozen one-shot planner.
candidates.already_done: Reachability+gradient optimization, local affected-object cleanup, learned fixed-set denoising, geometric guidance, conflict-group repair and verification are established. VIGOR even uses local projection then conflict-graph joint repair with attachment preservation. SceneReVis additionally covers mandatory-object multiplicity verification and SFT+GRPO learning of visual correction trajectories; simply learning an editor is insufficient.
candidates.possible_unproved_delta: An empirically demonstrated amortization/generalization advantage for a learned budget policy over the best same-initialization deterministic repair under the exact user task. New architecture or relation graph alone is insufficient.
candidates.lightweight_method_sketch: Freeze single-shot planner output; a small residual/order policy selects which coordinates/objects or conflict component to update. Deterministic verifier accepts only explicit geometry improvements while preserving inventory; distinguish user hard requirements from fallible LLM-inferred preferences. Do not require rendering or iterative VLM calls.

minimum_experiment.factorial: Cross2initializers (GPT one-shot, FastFill; add LayoutVLM when adapted) with raw/no repair, greedy projection, local Adam, conflict-component search and learned corrector. Reuse identical starting layouts.
minimum_experiment.budget: Quality curves at1/2/4/8correction rounds plus measured equal walltime/check-count caps; count any full model call, occupancy rebuild and global validation. No fair comparison based only on iteration count.
minimum_experiment.data: If training needed, synthetic corruptions of training layouts plus rollouts from frozen planner. Hold out source/house/catalog/count range; no test-tuned repair labels. Use existing supervised model only after correctness fixes.
minimum_experiment.upper_bounds: Long-budget solver is an oracle quality/time reference, not an equal-budget baseline; direct learned one-shot tests whether planner scaffold is necessary.

metrics: All-input exact-inventory feasibility and semantic requirement satisfaction
Geometry/contact/access proxies plus real-mesh stage on same subset
Number moved objects/displacement, relation damage, size/aspect-ratio distortion
Quality-versus-p50/p95latency, memory, verifier calls and LLM tokens/API cost
Generalization by source,count,density and unseen asset/size regime
ablations: Same learner without planner, geometry-only input, and shuffled semantic scaffold
Deterministic ordering versus learned risk ranking with identical repair operator
Same learner with no warm start versus same solver with warm start
Support/dependency information available equally; no GT hidden supports/symmetry in main protocol
Train corruption diversity versus simple Gaussian pose noise; native-size/exact-fit task branch held fixed
falsification: Same simple greedy/Adam/conflict search equals or beats the learned corrector at equal end-to-end latency.
Benefit stems entirely from GPT scaffold or unchanged deterministic spread/projector.
Claimed savings exclude prefill/raster/postprocess/verification cost or use more API calls.
Learning gains vanish on new house/source/object counts or are only singleGT pose similarity.

Only improvement is a faster implementation of standard solver, without a substantive learned/generalization insight: call it engineering/efficiency contribution, not broad new scene-generation method.
Equal-budget non-VLM local repair or an adapted SceneReVis-style corrective baseline supplies the same improvement; extra self-reflection/RL labels are not a novelty argument.
candidates.proposed_pilot_thresholds_not_facts: A meaningful target could be>=2xrepair speed at matched validity and blind-quality, or>=5percentage-point full-room success at matchedtime; choose one before evaluation. Neither threshold guarantees publishability.

cost.deterministic control/probe: 1-3engineer days once new workflow and common protocol fixed
cost.convincing multiple-source study: 2-4weeks; training compute unspecified until resources chosen

candidates.recommendation: Run as a control and product improvement first. Advance to a paper candidate only if a clean learned-vs-solver effect survives the factorial and budget tests.

candidates.title: 拥挤清单的可核验证据、失败分流与有限预算
candidates.current_verdict: Potentially useful benchmark/reliability contribution; weakest claim is simply returning UNSAT explanations. Need narrow formal domain and evidence of practical value.
candidates.new_hypothesis: A lightweight pipeline that distinguishes verified-feasible, conditionally-proved-infeasible and unresolved-within-budget cases can avoid false successful layouts and wasted repair compute on crowded fixed-inventory requests, while retaining a verifiable provenance trail.
candidates.already_done: Constraint satisfaction, pruning, unsat/IIS explanations, counterfactual repairs, geometric verification and finite-budget search are prior art. VIGOR screens for constructible examples, so hard/infeasible cases offer a different experimental population, not an automatic new algorithm.
candidates.possible_unproved_delta: A benchmark/protocol with both feasible witnesses and sound limited-domain infeasibility certificates under unknown-size priors, coupled to a measured budget-allocation benefit for the complete text-inventory-to-realization task. Do not conflate this with proving arbitrary 3Dpacking impossible.
fundamental_limits: If object dimensions are unconstrained and arbitrarily shrinkable, an overcrowded-room claim is often not identifiable. State a common catalog, allowed size bounds, aspect-ratio rules and support types first.
A failed heuristic or solver timeout is UNKNOWN, never proof of infeasibility.
A proof on a coarse grid or90degreeorientation set proves only that restricted model infeasible unless it is a valid relaxation whose infeasibility implies the full task.
OBB packing infeasibility does not imply arbitrary mesh packing infeasibility; chairs can fit under tables and supported objects may share projected area.
Cannot remove required furniture to claim success; propose relaxations as suggestions without applying them to the original request or counting them successful.
candidates.lightweight_method_sketch: Use analytic necessary bounds and exact logical contradiction checks first; optionally bounded LP/SMT/MIP only for a small explicitly restricted subset, followed by an independent checker. Generator produces layouts or proof objects or UNKNOWN with budget spent. No formal assertion based on LLM confidence.

certificate_examples.valid_domain: Fixed-height ground-blocking objects whose exact footprints must be disjoint and remain inside usable floor; known lower area bound perID.
certificate_examples.proof: If sum lower footprint areas exceeds usable floor area, no feasible packing in this domain. For stacked/under-table/wall/ceiling objects this argument is invalid unless exclusions proved.
certificate_examples.strength: Cheap but incomplete; no conclusion when bound does not fire.

certificate_examples.valid_domain: Only user-authorized hard constraints interpreted with fixed units/tolerances; e.g. same pair required distance<=a and>=b whereb>a.
certificate_examples.proof: Replay inequalities/unsat subset under canonical schema.
certificate_examples.strength: Not evidence LLM-inferred preferences make original user request impossible.

certificate_examples.valid_domain: Declared finite asset choices and placement/orientation domain or valid continuous relaxation.
certificate_examples.proof: Independent certificate check; explicitly say restricted-domain UNSAT.
certificate_examples.strength: May be too costly or too weak for main continuous problem; do not escalate into heavy runtime pipeline without evidence.

minimum_experiment.dataset: Construct small paired scenes: feasible cases have replayable verified witness; infeasible cases have independent analytic/solver certificate; near-boundary harder cases include UNKNOWN. Include adversarial stack/under-table examples that break naive area tests.
minimum_experiment.size: Start100-200synthetic restricted cases as correctness probe, plus50-100real validation room inventories for usefulness; synthetic proof accuracy does not establish real-room generalization.
minimum_experiment.controls: Same planner/repair under fixed timeout; no precheck, simple area threshold, calibrated learned abstention, certified precheck+budget routing. For budget gains include all precheck/checker overhead.
minimum_experiment.replay: Save request,assumptions,certificate/witness,checker version,tolerances,budget and retained inventory; independent checker can reject fabricated certificates.

metrics: Certificate soundness and domain coverage separately; zero observed false certificates is not proof of general soundness
Certified-infeasible recall on known-certified subset; UNKNOWN fraction over all inputs
Selective success/quality versus accepted coverage; all-request success and cost
Compute saved on actually-infeasible cases; cost/quality impact on feasible tight rooms
Correctness/minimality of suggested relaxations assessed separately from original task success
ablations: No uncertainty domain versus shared catalog/size bounds
Fixed versus adaptive budget at same total batchbudget
Heuristic failure labels versus certified labels (do not use former as truth)
falsification: Certificates falsely reject any known-feasible witness because constraints/size bounds are unsound.
Coverage negligible on real requests, or precheck overhead exceeds saved runtime.
Value only from easier test distribution or silently discarding difficult requests.
A simple necessary-area bound gives same utility; then method novelty weak, though reporting protocol may remain useful.
Achieving useful coverage requires heavy exhaustive solvers inconsistent with desired workflow; retain offline benchmark/oracle only.

cost.useful continuous/mesh certificate cover: Uncertain/high; not recommended as first implementation
cost.training: None required for sound checks; learned budget estimator optional and never itself a proof

candidates.recommendation: Treat initially as audit/benchmark side experiment and negative-control dataset. Do not make a universal impossibility claim.

shared_experimental_contract.no_protocol_leakage: Identical empty shell,openings,height,completeIDinventory,text and non-GT asset policy. Hide GT support/relations/symmetry except where explicitly user-provided. Legacy full-condition predictions stay separate.
shared_experimental_contract.strong_baseline: Keep reported winning GPT one-shot as primary comparator, same model/prompt/output schema and actual allowed budget where possible. Evaluate common repair on it as well. Do not only compare weaker FastFill raw.
shared_experimental_contract.quality: Separate inventory completeness, geometric validity,function/access,support/contact,realization success and blinded visual/semantic quality. GT pose/SG similarity auxiliary; two VLM scoring variants are not two independent human quality validations.
shared_experimental_contract.failure_denominators: All requested scenes and requiredIDs retained. Failure/unknown/N/A counts separate; no evaluation exception converted to zero violation or success.
shared_experimental_contract.geometry: OBB/2Drules labeled proxies. Real-mesh/physics claims need realizedassets/supportsurfaces and independent checks; NAVlargestcomponent is not door-connected agent reachability.
shared_experimental_contract.statistics: Paired scene comparisons; group/source/house clustered CI. Multipleassets/seeds nested within rooms. Fit priors/calibrators/thresholds only ontrain/validation, freeze before untouchedtest. Pilot effects are hypothesis-generation, not powered finalclaims.
shared_experimental_contract.budget: Report one-call versus multi-call,walltimep50/p95,candidatechecks,render/asset work and tokens; same hardware/cacheconditions. APIspend remainszero in this audit.
shared_experimental_contract.novelty_framing: No global-first claim. A stronger baseline or cleaner evaluation can justify an engineering contribution, but does not automatically make a new algorithm.

recommended_order: Wait for/inspect user lightweight workflow; do not redesign it by assumption.
Run first_gate pain-point probe with existing assets/results and common protocol.
Build deterministic geometry control atop best one-shot planner; this gives both a cheap improvement path and a hard test of learned contribution.
PursueC1 only if actual realization gap survives exact-fit/native mode distinction; keepC2 as essential baseline;C3 as selective reliability side study unless certificate coverage proves substantial.
not_claimed: Any candidate is globally novel or guaranteed publishable
Current FastFill loss correctness fixes are research innovations
The screenshot ranking proves one method globallysuperior
New lightweight user workflow already exists or is implemented
